svg.title: Background. 2026 to now: Co-founder, LEPV. Entrepreneurship league at IME. Set up its selection process and operating model; helped run its first hackathon, with FGV, in October 2026. 2025 to now: Coordinator, IME Júnior. Computing and people management at IME's junior enterprise. 2025 to now: Member, IME Finance. Financial markets league. 2025: Reserve officer aspirant, Brazilian Army. 2019, 2020: Brazilian Astronomy Olympiad. Silver medal in 2019, gold medal in 2020.
